prompts.title: Tasting notes for the bag
prompts.summary: Turns your cupping sheet into tasting notes and a bag page a non-expert understands.
prompts.prompt: Here's my cupping sheet for [coffee]: origin [ ], process [ ], roast level [ ], notes [ ], body [ ], acidity [ ]. Write: three tasting notes a regular coffee drinker would recognize, a two-sentence story of where it's from (only what I gave you), how to brew it (one method, one ratio), and a one-line label for the bag.
prompts.use: One per coffee. Put the brew line on the bag sticker too.

prompts.title: Wholesale note to a cafe
prompts.summary: A short, specific note to one cafe owner about carrying your coffee.
prompts.prompt: Write a short email to [cafe] in [town] about carrying [roastery]'s coffee. What I noticed about them: [something true]. What I'd offer: [price per lb, minimum, delivery, a free tasting]. Under 120 words, one question.
prompts.use: Bring beans when they say yes to a tasting.

prompts.title: Roast day reel
prompts.summary: A 15-second reel brief for roast day, with the sound moment planned.
prompts.prompt: Write a 15-second reel brief for roast day at [roastery]. Plan: the first second (beans dropping into the cooling tray), the first crack as the sound moment, four more shots in order, on-screen words (six at most), and a caption that names the coffee and when it ships.
prompts.use: Film it every roast day. Same shots, different coffee.

notes: Selling roasted coffee needs the food permits your state requires.
